Dickey Ridge → Stony Man is 42 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Stony Man → Big Meadows is 11 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Big Meadows → Swift Run Gap climbs about 720 m in 26 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Swift Run Gap → Rockfish Gap drops about 720 m over 58 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Skyline Drive
scenicChapters.narrative: For 15 km this is Skyline Drive, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Skyline Drive
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 47 km. 720 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Swift Run Gap → Rockfish Gap
scenicChapters.narrative: 106 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

skyline-drive.story: A one-way ride of 264 km, Front Royal to Waynesboro - roughly 3 h 33 in the saddle. On the way it passes Dickey Ridge, Stony Man, Big Meadows and Swift Run Gap. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: German Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 42 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Romantic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 34 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.
